direction.reason: Index in established downtrend (Price < EMA20 < SMA50); long setups restricted

springyDip.rule: OWN springy dip: lag-1 autocorrelation (120 bars) < -0.05 AND close at least 2 standard deviations under its 20-day average; buy at the open, sell at the close 5 sessions later

backtest.verdict: FAIL (too weak to rule out luck)

kronos.rule: Kronos-small forecasts each futures stock's close 5 sessions ahead from its last 512 daily NSE bars -> buy the top tenth, sell the bottom tenth at the next open, close both 5 sessions later
kronos.backtest: FAILED: +0.135% a rebalance, t 1.35, Jul 2024 - Oct 2026 (needs t >= 3)

trees.rule: the combined model's gradient-boosted trees rank the top-200 stocks on 56 NSE features every 5 sessions -> buy the top tenth, sell the bottom tenth at the open two sessions later, close both 5 sessions later
trees.backtest: PROMISING, not proven: +0.117% a rebalance, t 2.78, Oct 2022 - Oct 2026 (a PASS needs t >= 3 and the deflated Sharpe)

LU.rule: Long-unwinding bounce: the share fell at least 1.56% and its futures open interest fell at least 3.04% -> buy at the next open, sell at the close 10 sessions later
LU.backtest: FAILED as a short (−1.97% / −0.85% / −1.04% a trade); the bounce is that loss read the other way, untested

SB.rule: Short build-up: the share fell at least 1.56% and its futures open interest rose at least 3.04% -> short at the next open, cover at that day's close
SB.backtest: FAILED (+0.296% / +0.020% / +0.131% a trade; final t 1.86, not enough after 12 tests)

sbStrong.rule: Short build-up, strong signals only: the share fell at least 3% and its futures open interest rose at least 6% -> short the near-month future at the next open, cover at that day's close
sbStrong.backtest: PROMISING, not a pass (night lab 22 Oct 2026, priced on shares): 2005-2020 +0.118% a trade beyond the market, t 2.99; 2020-2026 +0.223%, t 2.73. On futures the same trades earn about 0.1% less (descriptive look, 23 Oct)

sbTrees.rule: Short build-up, the trees model's picks: every short build-up signal gets TAKE or SKIP from a model frozen on 2006-2026 data, using only what is known at 09:15; priced on the near-month future
sbTrees.backtest: PROMISING, not a pass (futures lab, 23 Oct 2026): the TAKE half beat the SKIP half by +0.191% a trade in 2008-2020 (t 6.31, DSR 0.94) and +0.111% in 2020-2026 (t 2.63)

daytrader.rule: AI day-trader: a trees model ranks every universe stock future from what is known at 09:15; long the top tenth, short the bottom tenth, open to close, on futures
daytrader.backtest: PASSED 2008-2020 (+0.25% a day, t 13.96) and CONFIRMED 2020-2026 (+0.10%, t 6.09), but decayed to +0.01% a day (t 0.63) from 8 Dec 2025 (audit 23 Oct 2026); spreads not modelled

flows.source: NSE fiidiiTradeReact (provisional, cash market), saved daily from the first day below

STRANGLE.rule: Sell the NIFTY call about 2% above and the put about 2% below, at the close of the first session with 4-10 days to the weekly expiry; hold to expiry
STRANGLE.backtest: PASS under protocol v2: +0.101% of NIFTY a week, t 4.66, 61 months (not significant after the 73-trial Deflated Sharpe check)

MA150A.rule: Short a stock whose close crosses below its 150-day average; cover 10 sessions later; scored against the market
MA150A.backtest: PROMISING: +0.338% a trade above the market, t 2.26

MA150B.rule: Short a stock whose 5-day average crosses below its 150-day average; cover 10 sessions later; scored against the market
MA150B.backtest: PROMISING: +0.307% a trade above the market, t 2.58

CHEAPVOL.rule: Buy the at-the-money stock straddle at the close when its implied volatility is below 0.8x the stock's 20-day realised volatility; sell at the close 5 sessions later
CHEAPVOL.backtest: +3.30% of premium a trade, t 1.94, 5,126 trades over 60 months — just short of the bar

INDREV.rule: Every 5th session: buy the 10% of stocks that lagged their industry group most over the last 5 sessions, short the 10% that led it most; close both 5 sessions later. Industry = NSE's own filings, which give none for about a third of the 200 stocks; those are compared with each other as one group, exactly as in the backtest
INDREV.backtest: +0.15% a rebalance, t 1.98, 248 rebalances over 60 months — just short of the bar

S2.rule: When the shares out on loan in NSE's lending market (SLB) jump to at least 2x their 20-day average, and at least 1 lakh shares: short the stock at the open of the 2nd session after that day's file, cover at the close 5 sessions later
S2.backtest: +0.26% a trade over the market, 55% winners, t 2.23, 2,085 trades over 61 months (NSE data atlas study, 12 Oct 2026) — promising, not proven
